Looping in deal and finance context. Summary of constraints: 
- Quill (Q4 reserved): 160 GPUs across the same cluster, 18-month commit, revenue > NovaEdge baseline.
- Pending burst (internal strategic partner POC): 40 GPUs for 6 weeks, high strategic value for marketplace integration.

Proposed tiebreak rubric for the allocation panel (we use this for similar escalations):
1) Contractual commitment (term length, signed MRR)
2) Customer impact (SLA/regulatory needs)
3) Time-sensitivity to launch (calendar hard dates)
4) Strategic upside (marketplace/partner commits)

By the rubric NovaEdge is between Quill and the burst POC: stronger SLO and earlier launch date than some, but Quill is a signed longer-term commit. Recommend we offer NovaEdge either (A) 70% headroom now with agreed ramp to full capacity by Nov 15, or (B) 50% dedicated + scheduled 4-hour high-priority windows to reach 120 during peak ops. Both options should include temporary burst credits and a one-time onboarding concierge.

I'll be on the allocation panel call at 09:00 Aug 31. Need Jonas to confirm the commercial levers (discounts, credits) we can offer in writing so we can close.

—Lauren
Head of Sales Strategy
